manifest.name: dsh-ascii-whales
manifest.description: Let whales drift through the quiet. An ASCII ocean and neutral frosted glass for DeepSeek Harness.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build

readme.text:
让鲸群游过留白，让思绪慢慢浮出水面。

新对话展开时，蓝色鲸群从字符之间游来。细小的鱼群随水流散开，尾迹缓缓隐去；输入框像一片磨砂玻璃，轻轻托住尚未写下的话。

[English](README.en.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ascii-whales) · [Releases](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales/releases)

在 DeepSeek Harness 的插件管理中添加 npm 包 **`dsh-ascii-whales`**，完成后重启相应实例。

Web CLI 用户也可使用：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ascii-whales
```

将 `web` 换成目标 Web profile。Desktop 请通过客户端插件管理安装。

插件默认启用，配置入口为 **设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼**。

动画铺在整个空白聊天主区域，位于标题与输入框后方。它保留原项目的 ASCII 字符色块、身体弯曲、鱼群游动与扩散尾迹；鲸鱼以不同大小游过，默认主色为 DeepSeek 蓝 `#4d6bfe`。

浅色像日光下的水面，深色像夜里的海。毛玻璃使用中性白／深灰透明层，没有额外的蓝色 tint；经过后方的鲸鱼会自然透出模糊的颜色。开始已有对话后，装饰自动退场。

选中的颜色落在鲸鱼身体的中间调，暗面压深、亮面提亮，保留逐格光照层次与身体立体感。两种主题沿用同一套鱼身配色，让你的那一抹蓝，在日夜之间都留得住。

新增 **字符风格 → Kanji**：改编自 MIT 许可的 [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)，使用鲸鱼形态，使用 stackedlol/ascii-sharks 的游动与鱼群模拟，保留 Kanji 上游按笔画密度生成的明暗与捕食文字效果。沿用数量、大小、速度、颜色、网格、尾迹和字体设置；字符栅格最低为 4 px（达到下限后不再缩小）。Kanji（日文汉字）使用“中文字体名称”；英文字体设置仅作用于 ASCII。字体离线内置，原有 ASCII／汉字鲸鱼仍可选。

使用 DSH 官方的设置页、按钮、输入框与开关。颜色区提供可视化色块及系统选色器，选色后即时生效。

也可以让汉字入海：**设置 → ASCII 鲸鱼 → 字符风格 → 汉字**。吻部落“吻”，眼睛落“目”，背部落“背”，胸鳍与背鳍落“鳍”，尾鳍落“尾”；其余鲸身由水、海、潮、鲸等字铺开，小鱼化作鱼字旁的游字。字随身体弯曲转向。三种样式按近似相同的字符格面积校准颗粒感：ASCII 保留窄格，汉字与 Kanji 使用方格，采用固定 CSS 像素尺寸，不随窗口宽度变化。1× 时 ASCII 为 8×12 px，汉字与 Kanji 为 10×10 px；仍可用“字符栅格”调节。

英文默认内置 **Geist Mono 600**，与原项目演示一致；汉字默认内置 **思源宋体**。两套字体用于动画，随插件离线加载。切换“字体 → 本机自定义”，可分别填写已安装的中英文字体名称，例如 `Consolas`、`方正屏显雅宋简体`。

点击 **扫描本机字体**，允许浏览器访问字体后，即可从下拉菜单中选择，也可直接输入字体名称。

| 设置 | 默认 | 范围 / 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 显示海洋 | 开 | 控制整个背景与配套玻璃 |
| 鲸鱼种类 | 座头鲸 | 座头鲸 / 虎鲸；三种字符风格均可切换并保存 |
| 字符风格 | ASCII | ASCII / 汉字 / Kanji；即时切换并保存 |
| 字体 | 内置默认 | 内置默认 / 本机自定义；中英文字体名称分别保存 |
| 眼睛底色 | 跟随主色 | 控制眼睛位置的背景方块；默认沿用身体底色，可选黑色／白色，字符自动使用对比色。Kanji 默认透明，选黑／白后增加眼睛底色块 |
| 彩色闪烁 | 关 | ASCII / 汉字：关闭使用主色深浅，开启恢复原版七色字符点缀；不改变身体主色。Kanji 使用自身闪光效果，此开关不适用 |
| 海洋颜色 | DeepSeek 蓝 | 可视化选色器；同步鱼群、尾迹配色 |
| 鲸鱼数量 | 3 | 1–20 |
| 鲸鱼大小 | 1.2 倍 | 0.1–10 倍，保留个体大小差异 |
| 游动速度 | 0.65 倍 | 0.1–10 倍 |
| 身体摆动幅度 | 0.8 倍 | 0–3 倍；0 关闭身体波动，仍会沿转弯路径弯身 |
| 转弯灵活度 | 0.7 倍 | 0.1–3 倍；越高越容易弯身掉头 |
| 摆尾频率 | 0.8 倍 | 0.1–5 倍；独立于游动速度 |
| 动画透明度 | 1 | 0–1；1 为完全不透明 |
| 字符栅格 | 1 倍 | 0.1–10 倍；越大越有颗粒感 |
| 底纹网格透明度 | 0.05 | 0–1；0 隐藏底纹 |
| 小鱼数量 | 170 | 0–1000；0 隐藏小鱼 |
| 尾迹强度 | 1 | 0–10；0 隐藏扩散尾迹 |
| 毛玻璃输入框 | 开 | 独立开关 |
| 玻璃模糊 | 14 px | 0–64 px |
| 玻璃不透明度 | 0.45 | 0–1；越高越不透 |

大小、栅格、速度、尾迹在 1 以下以 **0.05** 为步长，从 1 起以 **0.1** 为步长；跨界为 `0.95 ↔ 1 ↔ 1.1`，也可直接输入数值。

座头鲸保留长胸鳍和宽尾叶；虎鲸采用更宽的圆钝头部、短圆胸鳍，以及独立于眼睛底色的白色眼斑与侧腹斑。两种鲸鱼都保留自选主色，虎鲸白斑固定为浅白色。

三种样式均接入鲸鱼种类、显示开关、数量、大小、速度、透明度、字符栅格、网格透明度、小鱼数量、尾迹强度、颜色、字体及毛玻璃的开关／模糊／不透明度。颜色作用于身体、小鱼和尾迹；眼睛背景方块默认沿用身体底色，可单独选择黑色或白色；Kanji 的闪光与拟声文字保留主题强调色。

默认三条鲸鱼的相对大小为 100%、70%、84%。ASCII 小鱼以短横字符呈现，汉字模式使用鱼、鲤、鲭、鲱，尺寸随字符栅格一起变化。

**恢复默认** 使用 DSH 官方主按钮，随深浅主题切换，可一键回到最初的蓝色海面。偏好保存在当前浏览器。动画遵循系统“减少动态效果”设置，并在后台标签页暂停。

基于 [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks) 的源码改造。原作者完成了鱼群模拟、柔性身体、字符栅格与光影渲染；本项目在其基础上加入鲸鱼形态、DSH 集成、主题适配与可调参数。

**Kanji**样式改编自 [michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404) 创作的 **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)**（MIT License，Copyright © 2026 michikusa404）。汉字笔画密度明暗与文字特效源于该项目；本项目将形态改为鲸鱼，并负责 DSH 接入、透明背景、可调参数与离线字体适配。完整许可保留在 [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE)。

感谢 **michikusa404** 将汉字化作海洋，也感谢 **stackedlol** 创作的字符鱼群与动画实现。感谢两位原作者公开源码，让这片海能够游进 DeepSeek Harness。

固定的上游版本、改动范围与署名见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。毛玻璃实现参考了 [dsh-glass-theme](https://github.com/cnayu/dsh-glass-theme) 与 [dsh-skin-glass](https://github.com/noexcs/dsh-skin-glass) 的相关思路。

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run check
npm pack
```

动画与字体随插件一起打包，可离线加载。

测试与 GIF 录制见 [开发文档](docs/development.md)，测试结果见 [验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

Kanji 的游动、追逐、转向和身体摆动与 ASCII／汉字共用 stackedlol/ascii-sharks 运动模拟；保留鲸鱼轮廓，采用 Kanji 字符明暗和文字特效。

Let whales drift through the quiet, and thoughts rise to the surface.

A blue ocean unfolds behind each empty chat. Schools of tiny fish scatter between characters; wakes fade slowly, and a pane of frosted glass holds the words you have yet to write.

[中文](README.md) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ascii-whales) · [Releases](https://github.com/Chael-Chael/dsh-ascii-whales/releases)

Add **`dsh-ascii-whales`** through DeepSeek Harness's plugin manager, then restart that instance. For a Web profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ascii-whales
```

Open **Settings → ASCII Whales**. Use Desktop's own plugin manager for Desktop installations.

The animation fills the empty chat area behind the title and composer. It follows the native light/dark theme and disappears in existing conversations. Glass is neutral white or charcoal, with no blue tint; colors passing behind it are naturally blurred.

Your chosen color anchors the whale body's midtones, with deeper shadows and brighter highlights that preserve per-cell lighting and body volume. Both themes use the same body palette, carrying your shade of blue from daylight into night.

Choose **Settings → ASCII Whales → Character style → Hanzi** for Chinese characters: 吻 at the snout, 目 at the eyes, 背 along the back, 鳍 on fins and 尾 on tail flukes. Water and ocean characters fill the body; fish become 鱼, 鲤, 鲭 and 鲱. These labels follow the bending body. Hanzi use wider cells, adjustable with cell size.

The plugin embeds **Geist Mono 600** for ASCII, matching the upstream demo, and **Source Han Serif** for Hanzi. These animation fonts load offline. Choose **Font → Local custom** to enter separate installed English and Chinese font names.

Click **Scan local fonts**, allow browser access, then choose from the dropdown menus. You can also type a font name directly.

Humpbacks retain long flippers and broad flukes. Orcas have a broader rounded head, short rounded flippers, and white eye and flank patches. Both retain your selected body color; the orca patches stay off-white and are independent of the eye-background setting.

| Setting | Default | Range |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Show whales | On | Entire scene and its glass |
| Whale species | Humpback | Humpback / Orca; saved and available in all three character styles |
| Character style | ASCII | ASCII / Hanzi / Kanji; applied immediately and saved |
| Font | Bundled default | Bundled default / Local custom; separate saved English and Chinese names |
| Eye background | Follow main color | Controls the eye cell background, with contrasting text. Defaults to body shading; choose black or white. Kanji defaults to transparent and adds an eye tile only for black/white |
| Colorful shimmer | Off | ASCII / Hanzi: selected-color shades by default; enable the original seven-color glyph accents. Body color is unchanged. Not applicable to Kanji |
| Whale color | `#4d6bfe` | Visual swatches and system color picker; fish and wakes follow |
| Whales | 3 | 1–20 |
| Size | 1.2× | 0.1–10× |
| Speed | 0.65× | 0.1–10× |
| Body swing amplitude | 0.8× | 0–3×; zero removes body waves, while the spine still follows turns |
| Turning agility | 0.7× | 0.1–3×; higher values allow tighter turns |
| Tail-beat frequency | 0.8× | 0.1–5×; independent of swimming speed |
| Scene opac

Size, cell size, speed and wake step by **0.05** below 1 and **0.1** from 1 upward: `0.95 ↔ 1 ↔ 1.1`. You can also type values directly.

Set grid opacity, fish count or wake to zero to hide it. The default whales have relative sizes of 100%, 70% and 84%; the size control scales them together. Small fish are dashes in ASCII mode and fish characters in Hanzi mode; their dimensions follow the character grid.

Settings use official DSH controls. **Restore defaults** uses the theme-aware primary button and brings back the original blue ocean. Preferences are saved in this browser. The animation follows reduced-motion preferences and pauses in background tabs.

This adapts **[stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks)**, retaining its simulation, flexible spines, ASCII rasterizer and lighting. The whale shape, DSH integration, palettes and controls are adaptations. See [source attribution](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for the pinned commit and credits.

The **Kanji** style adapts **[ascii-kanji-sharks · 漢字の海](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks)** by **[michikusa404](https://github.com/michikusa404)** (MIT License, Copyright © 2026 michikusa404). Its ink-measured Kanji shading and text effects come from that project; movement and schooling use stackedlol/ascii-sharks. Our adaptations replace the shark silhouette with whales and add DSH integration, a transparent background, adjustable settings and offline fonts. The full license is preserved in [vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE](vendor/ascii-kanji-sharks/LICENSE).

Thank you to **michikusa404** for turning Kanji into an ocean, and to **stackedlol** for the character-based schools and animation. Their publicly shared source made it possible to bring this sea into DeepSeek Harness.

```sh
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps
npm run check
npm pack
```

Animation and fonts are bundled for offline loading. See [development and recording](docs/development.md) and [test results](docs/validation.md).

Choose **Character style → Kanji** for the MIT-licensed [ascii-kanji-sharks](https://github.com/michikusa404/ascii-kanji-sharks) simulation, adapted to whales: schools, ink-measured shading and feeding text effects. Existing population, size, speed, color, grid, wake and font controls apply. Cells have a 4 px minimum (lower settings stop shrinking at this limit). Kanji uses the Chinese font field; the English font field applies only to ASCII. Fonts are bundled for offline use; both whale styles remain available.

All three styles support visibility, count, size, speed, opacity, cell size, grid opacity, small fish count, wake intensity, color, fonts and the glass toggle/blur/opacity. Color affects bodies, fish and wakes; eye backgrounds follow body shading by default, with optional black or white. Kanji glints and sound effects retain theme accents. The first three whales use relative sizes of 100%, 70% and 84%.
Kanji shares the stackedlol/ascii-sharks simulation, pursuit, turning and body wave with ASCII / Hanzi, retaining the whale silhouette with Kanji shading and text effects.

Character cells use comparable areas across styles: ASCII retains narrow cells, while Hanzi and Kanji share square cells. Cell sizes are fixed in CSS pixels, independent of window width: at 1×, ASCII uses 8×12 px and Hanzi/Kanji use 10×10 px. The same multiplier gives similar grain density; full-width cells retain a 4 px minimum.
